text:
Ava (support): Hey team, ACME reports streaming sessions on Dedicated Private dropping mid-payload and sometimes resuming with duplicated partial tokens. Happening only from their corporate network behind a proxy.
Ben (eng-runtime): Do we have a repro pcap or trace? Is it TLS termination at their proxy or transparent pass-through?
Carlos (acme-corp): We captured a tcpdump and saw the SSE connection close after a burst, then client reconnect sends Last-Event-ID and we get overlapping chunks. Happens only for larger responses (~>1200B). Here's sequence we see: FIN from proxy, client reconnect, server resumes and sends same chunk header again.
Ava (support): Can you paste the curl you used to reproduce? Also what transport (HTTP/1.1) are you forcing?
Carlos (acme-corp): Repro command:```curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://dedicated.acme.redwood/api/v1/stream"``` We see the close after about 2-3s of streaming.
Dana (eng-infra): Quick hypothesis: corporate proxy does aggressive buffering or applies Nagle + delayed ACKs causing the proxy to flush in odd boundaries. Could be MSS/MTU causing fragmentation at the proxy and a middlebox treating fragmented TLS records as an error.
Ben (eng-runtime): Also check TCP keepalive/idle on the client side. If their proxy kills idle half-closed streams when no application-level heartbeat is present, the server may still be writing and then the proxy sends a reset/FIN. We have keepalive and optional SSE heartbeats in client libs but not always enabled.
Ava (support): Carlos, can you try 2 quick workarounds to narrow this down: 1) Force smaller chunk writes on our side (we can push a config to stream smaller event frames), 2) Ask your proxy team to set MTU to 1400 or disable TCP segmentation offload on the gateway for a short test.
Carlos (acme-corp): Will try. Also, the proxy team mentioned they use an older load balancer that does TLS handoff and applies HTTP/1.0 gateway behavior for long-lived streams.
Ben (eng-runtime): If their proxy converts to HTTP/1.0, chunked transfer semantics and SSE long polling can break — some proxies buffer until end of response. But since you see partial output then FIN, it's probably a middlebox timeout. Two more things to test: re-run with HTTP/1.1 explicitly and add a heartbeat SSE comment every 15s: `: ping\n\n`.
Dana (eng-infra): From infra side, we can instrument server to emit a small keepalive comment every 10s and also enable a 'resume-safe' flag where we mark event IDs so resumed streams can avoid re-sending already-acked chunks. That reduces duplicates on reconnects. Would you like us to enable that for ACME as a temporary mitigation?
Carlos (acme-corp): Yes please. Also, we tried disabling Nagle/TCP_NODELAY on our app client and saw fewer occurrences in initial test. Not conclusive though.
Ava (support): Good signal. We'll do two things: enable server-side lightweight heartbeats + resume-safe event IDs for their dedicated instance, and provide the ACME proxy team a short checklist to test MTU, TS/TTL and TLS offload behavior.
ingress-bot: [deploy] canary rollout to dedicated/acme/streaming: roll 1 -> 2 complete, new option `sse_resume_safe=true`, `sse_heartbeat_interval=10s`.
Ben (eng-runtime): After we push this, keep an eye on duplicate-event counts and connection resets per minute. If resets continue, we'll request a packet capture at the ingress to inspect TLS record boundaries.
Carlos (acme-corp): Rolling change looks good on our side, initial smoke tests show fewer duplicate tokens. We'll run a day of tests and report back. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Ava (support): Thanks all — please attach the pcap if the problem persists. If ACME's proxy team can temporarily allow direct egress to our dedicated IP (bypass TLS handoff), that will prove whether proxy TLS mutates frames.
Ben (eng-runtime): One more note for engineering: document a diagnostic checklist for Private/Dedicated streaming customers: HTTP version, TLS handoff vs passthrough, MTU/MSS, proxy timeouts, Nagle, keepalive interval, SSE heartbeat presence. Saves time on next incident.
Ava (support): Filed follow-up ticket with customer success to engage ACME proxy team. Thread will remain open until we confirm a stable 24h window with no reconnect duplicates.
